## Claim under review

Link the specific white paper section, research note, prior-art entry or test.

## Observed evidence

Primary sources, publication dates, applicable jurisdictions/units, and a short explanation of what each source establishes.

## Inference or counterexample

State the smallest worked case that supports or contradicts the claim; distinguish hypothetical inputs from real observations.

## Impact and proposed correction

What document, model, or assumption should change? What evidence remains missing?

Please do not submit investments, wallet addresses, private identity documents or third-party confidential material. Disagreement is welcome.
